issues.failure_explanation: The step gamma(M^2\A) <= rho_max nu_max L^2(M^2\A) presumes gamma has density <= rho_max nu_max w.r.t. L^2. A coupling gamma in Pi(mu_n, nu) with discrete first marginal is concentrated on the L^2-null set {x_i}xM, and even for continuous marginals an (optimal, Monge-type) coupling is singular; only the product coupling has such a density. Hence the mass of the bad set A^c under gamma is not controlled by mu^2(A^c), and the lemma's bound is unproved. The undefined constant mu_min also appears.
